inlines.v: GREE'NNESS, noun The quality of being green; viridity; as the greenness of grass or of a meadow. 1. Immaturity; unripeness; in a literal or figurative sense; as the greenness of fruit; the greenness of youth. 2. Freshness; vigor. 3. Newness.
